answer: Senior-bond absorption makes cloning a bet against your own flagship. The trigger is a confirmed duplicate: crystal-clear graph review links a fresh name to an established wallet. The rule draws each penalty, 30,000 POA per fake, from the oldest identity that wallet ever funded - the haven account carrying years of earned standing - not from the disposable clone. A farm of one hundred fakes therefore drains 3,000,000 POA from the flagship bond resting at the jetty, while a lone honest operator risks nothing at all.
